contact.contact_note: Guide expands profile S. Butler to Susanne Butler. Shared office/JA route; profile gives Suite384, guide mailing/physical block omits suite. No distinct personal judicial email established.

chambers_communications.summary: Email preferred, phone permitted. Include case number/name/matter in subject; copy all parties unless authorized exception; no duplicate inquiries or direct party/attorney contact with judge.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion before booking and coordinate opposing counsel; notice states coordination and reserved time. Short5–10minute hearings use designated online slots at least3business days ahead unless agreement and JA contact; do not book special-set slots. Longer/evidentiary hearings through JA with filed motion and agreed requested duration; confirm final date. Criminal motion-specific requirements intentionally not analyzed.

proposed_orders.summary: Email Word proposed orders to IRCJudge3@circuit19.org3business days before hearing.

courtesy_copies.summary: PDF materials, highlighted as needed, copied to opposing counsel; preferred3business days before evidentiary proceeding or as soon thereafter as practicable. Section contains inconsistent submission address (retained as conflict).

remote_appearances.summary: Guide permits attorneys by Zoom for non-evidentiary/non-testimonial hearings, meeting4949775734; defendants must attend docket calls in person. Evidentiary/testimonial remote appearance requires motion and agreement or hearing. Counsel supplies link to client/witness.

emergency_routing.summary: Email motion explaining emergency to court; court determines emergency and JA contacts counsel for setting. No repeated status inquiries.

noncivil_substantive_procedures.summary: Criminal merits, pleas, sentencing, program details, trial protocols and calendars outside commercial civil baseline; official links retained without substantive review.

facts.summary: Basic noncommercial contact and operating review completed. Guide supports full assistant name, shared office contact, coordinated scheduling, Word orders and remote-appearance distinctions. Courtesy-copy email variation retained.

stated_dates.note: No stated revision/effective date located in reviewed sections or date-label search of extracted guide; August2026 URL path is not asserted a revision date.

review_scope.content_reviewed: Profile contacts, assignment and link inventory; guide pp1–2 basic communications/general scheduling and pp6–7 general longer-hearing routing, remote appearance, orders, courtesy copies and emergency contact; guide p1 visually checked.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Remaining criminal-specific motion sections, pretrial/trial/plea/sentencing material, standing felony order, docket calendars and plea forms. Original guide fully collected but not fully substantively reviewed.
